arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_arcane: Launches an arcane missile that seeks the nearest hostile creature within 16 blocks, preferring creatures bearing an Arcane Mark, and chases it. It never targets its caster, the caster's team, tamed pets or summons, cannot pass through blocks and gives up a chase after a few seconds. Without a target it flies straight and fades away.

Brands the target with an arcane mark for 8 seconds, visible to every player. A creature can bear only one mark; marking it again refreshes the mark. Arcane Missiles and split projectiles prefer marked creatures.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_parasi: Binds the struck creature to you with a parasitic link for 8 seconds. While the link holds, every source of damage aimed at you strikes the host instead - before your armor or resistances apply, and with the host's own armor and resistances applied. The link breaks if the host dies or moves more than 32 blocks away. One link at a time; 20 second cooldown. Redirected damage is never redirected again.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_shrapn: When a projectile augmented with Shrapnel strikes a creature, it splits into two smaller homing projectiles that deal half damage and seek other nearby targets. Split projectiles never split again and do not strike the creature the original projectile hit.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_pursui: Sharpens the senses of homing projectiles: each Pursuit widens the target search radius, makes the projectile turn more sharply and lets it fly longer. Pursuit never increases damage.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_arcane_mi: The missile passes through an additional target or block.
The missile also collides with plants and other non-solid blocks.
Wider search radius, sharper turns and a longer lifetime.
On hitting a creature, splits into two half-damage missiles that seek other targets.

arcane_artifacts.page1.overview: Hello. These are the notes of Hellmerus Morra, Archmage of the School of Mysteries and, according to internal documents, "an employee who mostly copes". If you found this notebook on the floor, put it back on the floor. It is calmer there.
arcane_artifacts.page2.overview: Inside: the Research Table, artifacts, glyphs and about forty ways to die. My apprentice Pip asked for a forty-first, "because forty feels unfinished". We said no. Pip cried. Mr. Splotch, head of Human Resources and a slime, filed the tears in Pip's record.
arcane_artifacts.page3.overview: School rules. One: nothing can be copied; every recipe hides behind a research. Two: artifacts are made on the Enchanting Apparatus, glyphs at the Scribes Table. Three: do not call Mr. Splotch "jelly". He knows he is jelly. It just hurts to hear it.
arcane_artifacts.page1.rose_gold_ingot: 4 copper ingots and 4 gold ingots on a crafting table make 2 rose gold ingots. Used in almost every artifact. Also excellent for making other wizards jealous.
arcane_artifacts.page1.wreath_of_manipul: Worn on the head. When your mana runs dry, the wreath panics on your behalf and starts a Battle Rush: for 30 seconds every spell costs nothing and nothing can hurt you. Yes, nothing. Go wild.
arcane_artifacts.page2.wreath_of_manipul: Afterwards it needs 5 minutes (counted from the start) to recover, shown as Rush Exhaustion. /kill and the void still work: the wreath is brave, not stupid. The recipe is pricey: two Source Gem blocks, two Nether Stars and a Wilden Tribute. Heroism costs.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_boots: Worn on the feet. Self is sewn into the soles, so at the Scribes Table you inscribe only effects (Heal, Leap, Dig... your call). Crouch and the spell is cast on you, paid with your mana.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_boots: Holding crouch casts once; a short cooldown stops you crouch-spamming yourself into the next dimension. Other forms are refused: the boots know who they are.
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_gloves: A casting tool worn on both hands. Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table (no form = Projectile). Use the gloves: the spell is paid once and fires twice.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_gloves: The second cast is free and never triggers a third, Morra checked. Several times. Loudly. After a double cast the gloves rest for 3 seconds. Doubled Parasitism still makes only one link.
arcane_artifacts.page1.ring_of_reversal: Worn as a ring. When something hits you for more than half your maximum health, the ring says no. The hit is cancelled and the attacker flies back one block per point of damage it tried to deal. Hit hard, fly far.
arcane_artifacts.page2.ring_of_reversal: For arrows and spells, the shooter is the one who flies. Small hits pass as usual, so death by a thousand paper cuts is still on the table. /kill and the void are not impressed.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mantle_of_reflect: Worn on the back. Any projectile about to hit you has a 50% chance to turn around and go home: spells, arrows, tridents, fireballs, splash potions, strongly worded snowballs.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mantle_of_reflect: The reflected projectile keeps its speed and effects and now belongs to you. Allies' projectiles pass through, so friends can still hit you, which in a wizard party is statistically guaranteed.
arcane_artifacts.page1.status_effects: Things that can happen to you or to others because of this book. The School of Mysteries accepts no responsibility.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.arcane_mark: Arcane Mark. A glowing rune on the target for 8 seconds: Arcane Missiles and shrapnel go for it first. Rude, but effective.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasite_hos: This creature is a parasite's host: the damage its caster takes is delivered here instead. It did not sign up for this.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_bo: You are the parasite. Damage you take goes to the host while the link holds. Enjoy, briefly.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.parasitic_re: Parasitism cooldown: 20 seconds counted from the moment the link was made.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_arcane_: How it works: the missile scans 16 blocks around it (more with Pursuit) every few ticks and picks a target in this order: creatures with an Arcane Mark, then monsters and mobs attacking you, then others - the nearest one in each group. It never picks you, your team, your tamed pets or summons, players when PvP is off, or anything behind a wall. It steers toward the target every tick, so it can curve around. If it chases one target for 5 seconds without hitting it, it gives up on that creature for good. Without a target it flies straight; it fades after 10 seconds. On impact it resolves the rest of the spell like a Projectile, and Pierce, Split, Accelerate, Decelerate and Sensitive work as usual. Combos: Arcane Missile - Arcane Mark tags enemies for later missiles; Arcane Missile - Parasitism attaches a link from range; add Shrapnel and Pursuit for a swarm.

How it works: the mark is a status effect, so it is synced to every player and shows as a rotating rune circle. Only one mark exists per creature: a second mark refreshes the duration instead of stacking. Extend Time adds 4 seconds per augment, Duration Down shortens it. The mark itself does no damage - it is a target designator that Arcane Missile and Shrapnel understand.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_parasit: How it works: when the spell hits a creature, a link is created from you (the caster) to it. For 8 seconds, every time you would be hurt the damage is cancelled at the very first step and dealt to the host instead - before your shield, invulnerability frames, armour, enchantments, Resistance and absorption. The host then applies its own defences. Safety rules: redirected damage is never redirected again (two players linked to each other can not bounce damage); void damage and /kill always reach you; if the host is immune to that damage type (fire on a blaze...), it takes it as parasitic transfer damage instead, so an immune host can not shield you for free. The link breaks when the host dies, goes further than 32 blocks, you die, log out or change dimension. One link at a time and a 20 second cooldown; a second hit (for example the second missile of the Focusing Gloves) neither creates a new link nor extends it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_shrapne: How it works: when a projectile carrying Shrapnel hits a creature, two smaller turquoise homing projectiles burst from the impact point. They carry the same spell, deal 50% of its damage and seek the nearest other target - they ignore the creature that was just hit. Split projectiles never split again, so there is no chain reaction, and they cost no mana. Works with Projectile and Arcane Missile; Pursuit on the form also improves the split projectiles. Limit: one Shrapnel per spell.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_pursuit: How it works: each Pursuit (up to 3) adds 8 blocks to the search radius, makes the projectile turn sharper, lets it chase one target 1 second longer and lets it fly 5 seconds longer. It never changes damage. Pursuit only exists for homing forms such as Arcane Missile, because a straight projectile has nothing to improve.

arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Source Resonance
Source Gems hum near magic. Pip says they sing, and that the song is sad. Find out what they are actually about.
Cast any spell (any at all, we are not picky)
Observe lapis lazuli for comparison
Let a spell touch a living creature
Source is not fuel, it is a road: spells travel along it and take the shape of what they touch.
Trajectories
An arrow flies where it is sent and has never once asked why. Teach a spell the same devotion.
Cast a Projectile spell
Cast a spell with Accelerate or Decelerate
Hit a creature with Harm or Knockback
A projectile keeps its caster's intent; give it senses and it follows the target. (Arcane Missile, Pursuit, Aura)
Arcane Marking
Glowing ink shows in the dark. Can a living thing be marked so that magic knows it? Nobody asked the living thing, of course.
Cast Sense Magic, or make a creature glow
Hit a creature with Hex or Snare
A spell can leave a trace that other spells recognise. (Arcane Mark)
Fragmentation
A crystal splits along its inner lines. Mr. Splotch says he has inner lines too, and that this is not up for discussion.
Cast a spell with Split
Break or Crush a block with a spell
Magic splits like a crystal: one blow becomes several smaller ones. (Shrapnel)
Life Bond
Some creatures live off others. In nature it is called parasitism; at the Academy, mentoring. Study how life flows between bodies.
Wound a creature with Harm
Heal a creature with a spell (apologise)
Afflict a creature with Wither or Poison
Two lives can be bound so that harm, hunger and love flow from one to the other. (Parasitism, Full. Period., Cupid, Scroll of the Oath of Aid, the four Brotherhood charms)

arcane_artifacts.page1.research_guide: Science has three steps. Observe: put a sample in the circle of the Research Table and press Observe. Experiment: the table tells you what to do out in the world. Formulate: when it all worked, press Formulate. Pip applauds the table every time. The table does not react. Pip thinks the table is shy.
arcane_artifacts.page2.research_guide: A research that shows as ??? means you are not ready for it, and that is fine. We are not ready for most things in life. The page tells you which research comes first and which Ars glyph you must already know. Learn it and the question mark goes away, like many things do if you stare at them long enough.
arcane_artifacts.page3.research_guide: Notes come in four kinds: Material, Biological, Arcane and Spatial. They are never spent. Only what you do after a research has started counts. Once Pip set himself on fire in advance, "to get ahead of science". Science did not fall behind. Pip now draws his eyebrows on with a marker, and frankly they look better than the old ones.
arcane_artifacts.page1.research_table: A table that tells you things about other things. Put a sample in the circle and press Observe: it names its properties and starts every research the sample belongs to. The tabs at the top of the left page switch between the schools: Arcane Mage, Pseudomage and Druid. The right page lists the researches of the open tab, their experiments and what each unlocks.
arcane_artifacts.page2.research_table: The table never takes your sample and cannot be lied to. Morra once tried to convince it that he had been struck by lightning. The table waited. Then he was struck by lightning. The table approved.
arcane_artifacts.page1.old_parchment: Plain paper soaked in Source inside an Imbuement Chamber (500 Source, no pedestals), the same way an amethyst shard becomes a Source Gem. It ages at once and never fades again, which is more than can be said for most archmages.
arcane_artifacts.page1.researcher_notebo: Eight sheets of Old Parchment and one piece of leather on a crafting table: parchment all around, leather in the top right corner. Contains this very book. Yes, the book contains its own recipe. No, do not think about it for too long.
arcane_artifacts.lore.research_table: "The Scribes Table copies what is known. I needed a table that tells me about the unknown. Now it also tells me when I am wrong. I did not order that." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.old_parchment: "Old paper burns slower. I checked." - Hellmerus Morra. "He checked all evening." - Pip
arcane_artifacts.lore.researcher_noteboo: "If you are reading this, I am either dead or late for dinner. Pip, if it is you: dinner is in the oven. Mr. Splotch, if it is you: I am not dead, I just do not want to come to the meeting." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.rose_gold_ingot: "Copper soaks up magic, gold holds it, and together they are pink. Nobody believes me that the colour was a side effect." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.wreath_of_manipula: "I ran out of mana in the middle of a duel. My opponent said "oh". We both stood there not knowing what to do next. I wove this wreath so that pause never happens again." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.focusing_boots: "My hands were full, a mimic was eating my robe, nothing to cast with. I crouched. The mimic looked at me with respect. It was the high point of my career." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.focusing_gloves: "Why say a spell twice when your hands can remember it?" - Hellmerus Morra. "What if the hands remember something bad?" - Pip. We were quiet for a while.
arcane_artifacts.lore.ring_of_reversal: "A troll hit me for exactly half my health. On the way down I did the maths, thought about my mother and invented this ring. The troll apologised later." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.mantle_of_reflecti: "My colleagues answer arguments with fireballs. Now half the time they lose the argument to themselves, and look remarkably calm about it." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.research_property.chann: Magic flows through it like gossip
arcane_artifacts.research_property.mirro: Shiny enough to be smug about it
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Flesh Adaptation
Bodies survive fire, water and falls out of sheer stubbornness. Morra believes stubbornness can be studied. Pip believes it can be hugged.
Get burned
Run out of air underwater or inside a wall
Take a hit from a creature or an arrow
Pain is energy with bad manners: it can be stored, turned aside and returned. (Wreath of Manipulation, Ring of Reversal, Hop-n-Skip Slippers)
Focusing
A spell does not have to live in a book. It can be cosy in a boot, a glove or a staff. It can be cosy anywhere. That is a little hurtful, actually.
Cast a spell with Self
Cast a spell with Touch
Cast a spell with Projectile
A spell written into a thing obeys its owner's movements and repeats in skilled hands. (Focusing Boots, Focusing Gloves, Archmage Staff, Focusing Shield, Crystal Ball)
Reflection
A shulker hides in its shell and everything thrown at it is disappointed. Study that disappointment and learn to send it back.
Be hit by a projectile or a spell
Cast Bounce, or knock a creature back with a spell
A flying spell keeps its course only until something insists otherwise. (Mantle of Reflection, Mirror Shield, Ring of Calm)

arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_beam: An instant ray of magic from your eyes. It never passes through blocks: it stops at the first solid block and resolves on the first creature in its way (or on that block).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_black_: Opens a small black hole where the spell lands. It pulls in creatures, items and projectiles for a few seconds and damages whatever reaches its core. The caster is never pulled, and blocks are never broken.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_tornad: Raises a tornado where the spell lands. It spins creatures and items around and lifts them into the air; when it dies down, they fall. The caster is never caught.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_weathe: Changes the weather. Without Amplify the sky clears, with one Amplify it rains (or snows), with two a thunderstorm breaks out. Only works where there is a sky.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_counte: Cancels magic. On a creature, every spell it has in play vanishes and it is silenced for a few seconds. On a block, every spell in play nearby vanishes, whoever cast it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_meteor: Calls a shower of burning meteors down around the place the spell lands. Each one bursts on impact, burning and throwing back the creatures around it. The caster is spared; blocks are not broken or set alight.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_time_w: Slows time around the place the spell lands for everyone except the caster: creatures become very slow, and projectiles in flight lose most of their speed.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_beam_glyp: The beam passes through one more creature.
The beam also stops at plants and other non-solid blocks.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_black_hol: Stronger pull and more damage in the core.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_weather_s: One: rain. Two: thunderstorm. None: clear sky.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_countersp: On a block: cancels spells in a wider area.
On a creature: a longer silence.
On a creature: a shorter silence.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_meteor_sh: Two more meteors over a wider area.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_time_warp: A wider bubble of slow time.
Time is only a little slower.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.battle_rush: Wreath of Manipulation. For 30 seconds spells cost no mana and you take no damage (except /kill and the void). Milk does not remove it, why would you want it to.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.rush_exhaust: The wreath is catching its breath: no new Battle Rush until this ends (5 minutes from the start of the rush).
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.silenced: Counterspell. You cannot cast Ars spells until it ends. Milk helps. So does sulking quietly.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_arcane: Tip: the missile is not chasing you. If it is chasing you, sit down and think about what you have done.
Tip: marking a friend "so the missiles know who the good guy is" is an interesting idea. The missiles disagree.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_parasi: Tip: the creature did not consent. Creatures are rarely asked. It is sad, and we live with it.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_shrapn: Tip: two halves of a problem are still one problem. Just with two addresses.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_pursui: Tip: the missile is persistent, not psychic. It looks around corners with hope, not knowledge.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_beam: Tip: the beam does not pass through walls. Morra learned this inside a wall. The wall learned something too.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_black_: Tip: do not open it under your own feet. Not under Mr. Splotch's either. He remembers.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_tornad: Tip: whatever goes up comes down. Pip went up on Tuesday. We are still waiting.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_weathe: Tip: summoning a storm while holding a lightning rod is brave. The last one who did it glows on holidays now.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_counte: Tip: if two wizards counter each other at once, there is silence. It is a good time to apologise.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_meteor: Tip: the meteors spare the caster. Not the caster's house. Nobody ever spares the caster's house.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_time_w: Tip: time slows for everyone but you. Use it to ask yourself whether you are living right. Then you can go back to fighting.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_beam: How it works: the ray reaches 24 blocks (+8 per Accelerate), stops at the first solid block and resolves the rest of the spell on the first creature it meets - or on the block if it meets none. Each Pierce lets it go through one more creature. Sensitive makes it stop at grass and flowers too.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_black_h: How it works: a 6-block singularity (+2 per AOE) lasts 5 seconds (longer with Extend Time). Everything inside is pulled toward the core - creatures, dropped items, arrows - harder the closer it gets. The core deals 3 magic damage twice a second (+1.5 per Amplify). The caster, spectators and creative players are ignored; blocks are never broken.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_tornado: How it works: a 4-block whirlwind (+1.5 per AOE) for 6 seconds. It spins creatures and items around, slowly pulls them in and lifts them; when it ends they fall. It deals no damage by itself - gravity takes care of that.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_weather: How it works: no Amplify clears the sky, one Amplify starts rain (snow where it is cold), two or more start a thunderstorm. The new weather lasts about 10 minutes (Extend Time makes it longer). Does nothing in the Nether or the End: there is no sky to argue with.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_counter: How it works: on a creature it destroys all its spell projectiles, lingering spells and walls within 64 blocks, stops its black holes, tornadoes and meteors, cancels the free repeat of its Focusing Gloves, and Silences it for 5 seconds. On a block it destroys every spell in play within 4 blocks (+2 per AOE), whoever cast it. Only Ars Nouveau magic is affected.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_meteor_: How it works: 5 meteors (+2 per AOE) fall one after another around the target and burst on impact for 6 damage (+2 per Amplify), less at the edge, setting creatures on fire and throwing them back. Blocks are never broken or ignited, and the caster is never hurt.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_time_wa: How it works: within 6 blocks (+2 per AOE) every creature except the caster gets Slowness IV (stronger with Amplify) and Mining Fatigue for 6 seconds, and projectiles in flight lose three quarters of their speed.

Firmament
Fire falls from the sky, and rain, and sometimes the meaning of life. The sky is clearly listening to someone. Find out who and stand next to them.
Set something on fire with a spell
Call lightning or a cold snap with a spell
Get burned (again)
The sky listens to whoever shouts loudest. (Weather Shift, Meteor Shower)
Nullification
Milk cancels potions. Feather falling cancels falls. Fridays cancel plans. Everything has something that cancels it.
Dispel a creature
Observe a bucket of milk at the Research Table
Be hurt by magic
Every spell has a loose thread; pull it and it all unravels. (Counterspell, Pity, Harmless, Fear)

arcane_artifacts.page1.spell_staff: A spell book that went to the gym. It works exactly like an Ars spell book (book key to inscribe, radial menu, archmage-tier glyphs) but holds 5 spells instead of 10.
arcane_artifacts.page2.spell_staff: Two Amplify glyphs are carved into the wood: every spell cast FROM THE STAFF gets +2 Amplify for free. Carrying it in your other hand does nothing, the staff is not a lucky charm. Made from an Archmage Spell Book, so say goodbye to 5 slots.
arcane_artifacts.page1.bottomless_belt: Worn on the belt. Three bottomless pouches, each holding one kind of item in any amount: a million cobblestone fits in a pouch the size of a sandwich. Press B to open it.
arcane_artifacts.page2.bottomless_belt: Once a pouch holds something, every item of that kind you pick up or mine flies straight in, like a hopper with ambition. Left click a pouch to put your stack in or take a stack out, Shift-click to take into the inventory, right click to shovel in everything matching.
arcane_artifacts.page1.amulet_of_opposit: Worn around the neck. Right-click it in your hand, or press the toggle key (N by default, see Controls) while wearing it, to flip polarity (and colour). Attraction: items and experience orbs in a wide radius fly to you. Repulsion: they are pushed away.
arcane_artifacts.page2.amulet_of_opposit: While repelling, crouch to let things come close, so you can still pick them up. Things you have just thrown are left alone, otherwise dropping trash would be impossible. Morra tried.
arcane_artifacts.lore.spell_staff: "A book is for reading. A staff is for pointing. Pointing is much nicer. Please do not tell the Council." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.bottomless_belt: "Once I carried four hundred potatoes up a hill in my sleeves. Now I have a belt. The potatoes are still with me. I have grown attached to them." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.lore.amulet_of_opposite: "Opposites attract." - Hellmerus Morra. "Are me and Mr. Splotch opposites?" - Pip. "No, Pip. You are just standing next to each other." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Hoarding
A hopper swallows everything and never complains. Mr. Splotch holds it up as an example to the whole department.
Pick something up with the Pickup glyph
Pull a creature with a spell
Observe a lodestone or an ender chest
Space can be folded into a pocket, and a pocket can call things home. (Belt of Bottomless Pouches, Amulet of Opposites)
arcane_artifacts.page1.rose_gold_nugget: One rose gold ingot breaks into 9 nuggets, and 9 nuggets fuse back into an ingot. Nuggets go where a whole ingot would be wasteful: the Secret Notebook binding, the Wreath, the Oath Scroll.
arcane_artifacts.lore.rose_gold_nugget: "Small change for an archmage. Rent for an apprentice. For Mr. Splotch: material liability." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.rose_gold_block: Nine rose gold ingots make a block (and a block gives the nine back). The heaviest artifacts and the greatest glyphs need whole blocks: the Wreath, the Belt, Black Hole, Meteor Shower, Parasitism, Anvil Drop. It also works as a beacon base, if you are the showing-off kind.
arcane_artifacts.lore.rose_gold_block: "I built a tower of them. The Council called it tasteless. Pip said it looked like a sunrise. I still do not know which of them to believe." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_scroll: Scroll of the Oath of Aid
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_scroll.lore: Those who signed fight as one. Those who did not scrub the cauldron.
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_scroll.desc.1: First use: founds a company (rename the scroll on an anvil to name it).
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_scroll.desc.2: Use with a suit charm in the other hand: swears it to the company forever.
item.arcane_artifacts.oath_scroll.desc.3: Companions wearing sworn charms cannot hurt each other.
arcane_artifacts.page1.oath_scroll: The Scroll of the Oath of Aid founds a sworn company. The first time it is used it takes a company name: the scroll's own name if you renamed it on an anvil, otherwise yours. Hold a suit charm in the other hand and use the scroll: the charm is sworn to the company forever. It cannot be unsworn, resworn or argued with.
arcane_artifacts.page2.oath_scroll: Everyone who wears a charm sworn to the same company (in the charm slot) is a companion: companions cannot hurt each other, nor each other's pets, by blade, arrow or spell, and the addon's glyphs treat them as allies. One scroll swears any number of charms, so pass it around the table. Only one suit charm can be worn at a time.
arcane_artifacts.lore.oath_scroll: "For a thousand years the Oath of the Four Suits bound kingdoms. We use it to decide who scrubs the cauldron. Pip signed in blood. Nobody asked him to." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.heart_charm.lore: The suit of the healers. They carried the wounded off every field and never asked why they had gone there.
item.arcane_artifacts.diamond_charm.lore: The suit of the treasurers. They counted this charm too. Twice.
item.arcane_artifacts.club_charm.lore: The suit of the vanguard. First through every gate. Sometimes the gate was shut.
item.arcane_artifacts.spade_charm.lore: The suit of the wardens. They are still digging. Nobody told them the war is over.
item.arcane_artifacts.heart_charm.desc.1: Sworn: +3 hearts of maximum health and 20% knockback resistance.
item.arcane_artifacts.club_charm.desc.1: Sworn: +2.5 attack damage and 15% attack speed.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.well_fed: Satiety. Hunger stays full and saturation never runs dry while it lasts. Eating is still allowed, purely for pleasure.
arcane_artifacts.amulet.none: You wear no Amulet of Opposites
arcane_artifacts.oath.founded: The oath is sealed. The company "%s" is founded.
arcane_artifacts.oath.need_charm: Hold a suit charm in the other hand to swear it
arcane_artifacts.oath.already_sworn: This charm is sworn to "%s" forever
arcane_artifacts.oath.sworn: %s is sworn to "%s". Forever. No take-backs.
arcane_artifacts.oath.unsworn: Not sworn. Use a Scroll of the Oath of Aid.
arcane_artifacts.command.unlock_all: %s now knows every research and every glyph
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_anvil_: Drops an anvil from the sky onto the target: 60 damage. AOE makes the anvil bigger and turns the landing into a mace-like slam around it. Amplify makes it a very heavy anvil: 120 damage. Very expensive.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_anvil_dro: A bigger anvil; its slam hits everything around (half damage).
A very heavy anvil: 120 damage instead of 60.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_anvil_: Tip: look up. No, the other up. There. Sorry.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_anvil_d: How it works: an anvil appears 14 blocks above the target and falls, faster and faster. Whatever stands under it takes 60 damage (120 with Amplify). With AOE the anvil grows and lands like a mace: everything within 3 blocks (+1.5 per AOE) takes half damage and is knocked away. No block is placed and nothing is broken. Costs 350 mana. The area is marked while the anvil falls, so the target has exactly enough time to regret.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_satiet: Fills the target's hunger and keeps it full (Well Fed) for a minute. Cast on a block, it feeds the caster.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_satiet: Tip: a wizard who does not need to eat has more time for snacks. We checked. It is strange, but true.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_satiety: How it works: the target (or the caster, if the spell hits a block) gets Well Fed for 60 seconds (more with Extend Time): hunger is refilled to full every second and saturation is kept topped up. Costs 60 mana.
item.arcane_artifacts.heart_charm.desc.2: Swear it with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid. Bound forever.
item.arcane_artifacts.heart_charm.desc.3: Companions of the same company cannot hurt each other.
arcane_artifacts.page1.heart_charm: Charm of Hearts, the healers' suit. Worn in the charm slot. Once sworn to a company with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid it gives +3 hearts of maximum health and 20% knockback resistance, and its bearer cannot be hurt by companions.
arcane_artifacts.lore.heart_charm: "Four suits, one brotherhood. I proposed a fifth, but Mr. Splotch said there was no budget for it, and looked at me the way only slimes can." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.diamond_charm.desc: Swear it with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid. Bound forever.
Companions of the same company cannot hurt each other.
arcane_artifacts.page1.diamond_charm: Charm of Diamonds, the treasurers' suit. Worn in the charm slot. Once sworn to a company with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid it gives +3 luck and 8% movement speed, and its bearer cannot be hurt by companions.
arcane_artifacts.lore.diamond_charm: "Diamonds always know what a friendship costs. It does not make them bad friends. It makes them very precise friends." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.club_charm.desc.2: Swear it with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid. Bound forever.
item.arcane_artifacts.club_charm.desc.3: Companions of the same company cannot hurt each other.
arcane_artifacts.page1.club_charm: Charm of Clubs, the vanguard's suit. Worn in the charm slot. Once sworn to a company with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid it gives +2.5 attack damage and 15% attack speed, and its bearer cannot be hurt by companions.
arcane_artifacts.lore.club_charm: "Clubs go first through every door. Sometimes the door turns out to be a wall. Clubs go through that too." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.spade_charm.desc.2: Swear it with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid. Bound forever.
item.arcane_artifacts.spade_charm.desc.3: Companions of the same company cannot hurt each other.
arcane_artifacts.page1.spade_charm: Charm of Spades, the guardians' suit. Worn in the charm slot. Once sworn to a company with a Scroll of the Oath of Aid it gives +4 armour and +2 armour toughness, and its bearer cannot be hurt by companions.
arcane_artifacts.lore.spade_charm: "Spades dig trenches and hold the line. Once they dug so deep they found another brotherhood down there. They are pen pals now." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.wreath_of_manipula: Worn by the archmages of the Inner Circle. And by one very self-confident gardener.
item.arcane_artifacts.ring_of_reversal.l: Everything thrown at the wearer comes back. Except exes.
item.arcane_artifacts.mantle_of_reflecti: Woven of mirror silk by moonlight. The moon was against it.
item.arcane_artifacts.amulet_of_opposite: Two poles, one chain. It still has not decided who it is.
item.arcane_artifacts.bottomless_belt.lo: Every pouch leads somewhere. We do not look.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_boots.lor: Every step is a word of the spell. Running is shouting.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_gloves.lo: Point, and it happens. Do not point at Pip.
item.arcane_artifacts.ring_of_calm.lore: It hums softly when the world is calm. The world is rarely calm.
After a minute with no hostile creatures within 16 blocks: Speed II and Mana Regeneration II.
Tells you, with feeling, who has just shown up.
item.arcane_artifacts.hop_slippers.lore: Inspired by rabbits. The rabbits were consulted. They did not answer.
Jump Boost II and Luck II.
Weightless landings: half fall damage, and 4 more blocks before it starts.
item.arcane_artifacts.mirror_shield.lore: Look into it and watch your spell come home.
item.arcane_artifacts.mirror_shield.desc: Raised: spell projectiles from the front fly back to their caster.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_shield.lo: It has an answer for every blow. Sometimes a rude one.
item.arcane_artifacts.focusing_shield.de: Inscribe a spell at the Scribes Table (from a spell book or the Archmage Staff).
Every block casts it (at most once a second). Healing spells are refused.
arcane_artifacts.focusing_shield.invalid: The Focusing Shield refuses this spell: it must not be empty and must not heal.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.pity: Every spell you cast is weakened as if it carried two Dampen (four at level II). From the Pity glyph, the Gilded Fermented Spider Eye, and for the whole cooldown after a Battle Rush. Milk helps.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.bonk: Stunned. You cannot walk, jump, fly or even turn your head. 8 seconds, cannot be extended, cannot be cured. A Hard Hat helps.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_pity: Fills the target with pity: every spell it casts is weakened as if it carried two Dampen (four with Amplify) for 20 seconds.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_pity_glyp: Deeper pity: like four Dampen instead of two.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_pity: Tip: nothing hurts an archmage more than pity. Except maybe an anvil. But pity hurts more.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_pity: How it works: the creature hit gets Pity for 20 seconds (+1 second per Extend Time). While it lasts, every Ars spell it casts gets -2 amplification (-4 with Amplify), like two Dampen. Its catalyst is the Gilded Fermented Spider Eye.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_cupid: The target animal falls in love, as if fed. One animal at a time: AOE and Amplify do nothing, and it cannot be combined with Burst.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_cupid: Tip: aim carefully. Mr. Splotch is still in love with a filing cabinet, and it is not funny anymore.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_cupid: How it works: an adult animal hit by the spell enters love mode, exactly as if it had been fed its favourite food, and looks for a partner. Babies and animals that bred recently are ignored. It takes no augments, and the Scribes Table refuses it in a spell with Burst (and Burst with it).
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_harmle: An augment for any effect: the spell deals no damage and breaks no blocks. Everything else still happens.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_harmle: Tip: perfect for training, pranks and very awkward dates. Do not ask about the dates.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_harmles: How it works: put it after any effect. Every damage the spell would deal (Harm, Flare, Black Hole, Meteor Shower, Anvil Drop...) becomes zero, it breaks no blocks, and its explosions destroy nothing. Knockback, status effects, BONK! and the rest stay.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_anvil_dro: BONK! Only 12 damage, but the target is stunned for 8 seconds.
enchantment.arcane_artifacts.hard_hat.de: Shortens BONK!: by a third per level; at level III it lasts one second.
enchantment.arcane_artifacts.heavy_proje: Bolts deal 20 damage and BONK! the target, but take 10 seconds to load. Only Mending, Unbreaking and Curse of Vanishing can share the crossbow.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.explosive: Someone explosive is right next to you (%s). Do not hug it.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.undead: The undead have risen from the dead again (%s). Typical.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.phantom: You have not slept, and it noticed (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.ender: Do not look it in the eyes. You just did, did you not? (%s)
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.witch: A colleague! A very rude colleague (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.illager: Someone with an axe and a grudge against villages (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.slime: Something bouncy and sticky (%s). Do not step in it.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.fire: It is about to get hot (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.piglin: Gold-lovers nearby (%s). Hide your rose gold.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.breeze: A draught. A very aggressive draught (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.shulker: A box that bites (%s). You will float.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.guardian: Something with a laser eye is watching (%s).
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.warden: Shh. SHH. It hears you (%s). I am taking a break until you leave.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.dragon: Oh. Oh no. The DRAGON (%s). I will be in your pocket.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.wither: The Wither (%s). Whose idea was this? Yours. It was yours.
arcane_artifacts.calm_ring.other: Something hostile is near (%s). I do not like its face.
arcane_artifacts.page1.enchanted_poisono: Eight blocks of rose gold around one poisonous potato. Eat it: Magic Absorption III (a 12-point shield against magic damage), Regeneration II, Mana Regeneration II, Spell Damage and, because it is still that potato, a few seconds of Nausea.
arcane_artifacts.lore.enchanted_poisonou: "The most expensive potato in history. Still a little poisonous. Pip named it Gordon and cried when it was eaten." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.gilded_pufferfish: Eight rose gold ingots around a pufferfish. Eat it: Water Breathing for 3 minutes, Dolphin's Grace, Resistance and a short Nausea. The spikes are gilded too.
arcane_artifacts.lore.gilded_pufferfish: "The gold does not make it less spiky. It makes the spikes more expensive. There is something honest in that." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.gilded_fermented_: Eight rose gold nuggets around a fermented spider eye. Eat it, or press it onto a creature: 30 seconds of Pity (every spell weakened like two Dampen). It is also the catalyst of the Pity glyph.
arcane_artifacts.lore.gilded_fermented_s: "It looks at you with such pity that spells stop believing in themselves. I held its gaze for four seconds. Then I went and called my mother." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.ring_of_calm: Worn as a ring. Once a minute has passed with no hostile creatures within 16 blocks you get Speed II and Mana Regeneration II. The moment a hostile creature or a boss comes within 16 blocks, the bonuses stop, the minute starts again, and the ring tells you, in its own words, what kind of trouble it is.
arcane_artifacts.page2.ring_of_calm: It comments on creepers, the undead, spiders, endermen, witches, illagers, slimes, blazes and ghasts, piglins, silverfish, breezes, shulkers, guardians, the Warden, the Ender Dragon and the Wither. One remark per new kind of trouble, so a horde does not flood your chat.
arcane_artifacts.lore.ring_of_calm: "I made a ring for peace and quiet. Every five minutes it tells me who wants to kill me. Now I am calm, but for different reasons." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.hop_slippers: Bunny slippers for the feet slot, crafted cheaply on the Enchanting Apparatus: leather boots in the middle, rabbit hide, rabbit's feet and white wool around. Jump Boost II, Luck II and weightless landings: half fall damage, and 4 more blocks of safe falling.
arcane_artifacts.lore.hop_slippers: "Serious wizards do not wear bunny slippers. Serious wizards do not jump three blocks high. I chose jumping." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mirror_shield: A shield polished like a mirror. While it is raised, spell projectiles that hit it from the front fly back toward their caster, and the caster gets to enjoy their own work. Each reflection costs a point of durability. Repaired with rose gold.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mirror_shield: "The best answer to a spell is the same spell coming home. Like a son who moved to the big city and finally understood." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.focusing_shield: Inscribe a spell on it at the Scribes Table, the same way as on a spell book: hold the shield and use the table with a spell book or the Archmage Staff. Every successful block casts that spell (mana is paid as usual), at most once a second, aimed where you look.
arcane_artifacts.page2.focusing_shield: Healing spells are refused: the shield answers blows, it does not shrug them off. Empty spells are refused too. Repaired with rose gold.
arcane_artifacts.lore.focusing_shield: "It takes a blow and answers with a spell. Pip said it is like a conversation. I did not ask who Pip talks to like that." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.enchantments: Hard Hat (helmets, I-III). Every level cuts BONK! by a third; at level III it lasts one second. It also counts when the enchanted helmet is worn in a Curios head slot. From the enchanting table, books and librarians.
arcane_artifacts.page2.enchantments: Heavy Projectile (crossbows). Bolts hit for 20 damage and BONK! the target, but loading takes 10 seconds. Only Mending, Unbreaking and Curse of Vanishing can share the crossbow: anything else is refused at the anvil and falls off the crossbow when you start loading it, whatever mod it comes from.
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Shine Light on a block or a creature
Blow something up with Explosion
Trade places with Exchange
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.magic_absorp: Like Absorption, but only for magic: a shield of 4 points per level soaks up magic damage (spells, potions, Ars Nouveau) before your health does. Ends when the shield is used up.
arcane_artifacts.research.revealed: A new sample reveals the next experiment
item.arcane_artifacts.crystal_ball.lore: It shows the future. The future makes a rude gesture back.
3 spells. Every spell cast from it gets +2 AOE.
Its spell is thrown like a heavy ball, in an arc; one cast every 3 seconds.
arcane_artifacts.crystal_ball.recharging: The Crystal Ball is still clouded...
arcane_artifacts.page1.crystal_ball: A casting focus like a spell book, with 3 spell slots (same crafting screen and radial menu). Every spell cast from it gets two AOE for free, as if two AOE glyphs were set in the glass.
arcane_artifacts.page2.crystal_ball: Its spell is not a straight projectile: it is a heavy glass ball thrown in an arc. It leaves the hand a little upwards, gravity bends it down and the air slows it, so aim high for far targets. Where it lands, the spell resolves. And the ball needs time to clear: one cast every 3 seconds. Crafted on the Enchanting Apparatus around an Apprentice Spell Book.
arcane_artifacts.lore.crystal_ball: "I asked the ball whether my students would pass the exam. It showed me a fire. I asked whose. It showed me Pip. Pip waved." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_aura: A projectile augment: while it flies, the spell's effects wash over every creature it passes (once each). With Sensitive it also touches the blocks under its path. AOE makes the aura wider.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_projectil: While flying, the spell's effects touch every creature nearby (once each); with Sensitive also the blocks below.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_aura: Tip: a Heal projectile with Aura over your friends is called "care". Over your enemies, "a misunderstanding".
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_aura: How it works: put it after Projectile (or Arcane Missile). Four times a second the flying projectile releases its effects on every creature within 2 blocks (+1 per AOE), each creature only once; the caster is never touched by the aura. With Sensitive the aura also hits the first solid block below the projectile, each block once. The projectile still hits normally at the end.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_desc.glyph_fear: Frightens the target: it runs away from the caster and cannot act on its own for 6 seconds. Amplify makes it run faster.
ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_fear_glyp: The frightened creature runs away faster.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_joke.glyph_fear: Tip: works on creepers. Creepers get scared, and then come closer anyway. That is what courage is.
arcane_artifacts.glyph_doc.glyph_fear: How it works: the creature gets Fear for 6 seconds (+1 per Extend Time). It forgets its target, attacks nobody and runs away from the caster; each Amplify makes it run faster. Players are pushed away. Milk cures it.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.fear: Runs away from whoever frightened it, forgets its target and attacks nobody. Higher levels run faster. Milk helps.
item.arcane_artifacts.bottle_of_source.d: Pour it into a Source Jar: +100 Source. A crafting resource.
arcane_artifacts.mudzya_hive.empty: Not enough Source in the hive: %s / %s
arcane_artifacts.distiller.source_ok: Source Jars nearby have enough Source (%s per brew)
arcane_artifacts.distiller.source_missin: Needs %s Source per brew in Source Jars within 6 blocks
arcane_artifacts.page1.mushroom_caves: Deep under dry lands lie the Mushroom Caves. The moss grows in patches and changes colour in bands - blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple, white, grey - and in each band grow mushrooms of the same colour, as if they had agreed. Between the moss: dirt, mud and mycelium; huge blue, red and brown mushrooms, spore tufts, glowsprouts and hanging hyphae. You can see everything in the dark: the caves glow by themselves, quietly and a little apologetically.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mushroom_caves: Every small mushroom is a snack with a short effect of its colour; distilled, it gives the full effect. The Mycelinoids live there, in houses of huge mushrooms, guarded by Amanitoids. Monsters live there too: the glow of the caves is seen by eyes, not by spawning rules. Bone meal turns a blue mushroom into a huge one. Nobody knows whether it wants that.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mushrooms: Eaten raw, each gives a short effect; distilled, the full one. Blue Mushroom: Night Vision; Sourcecap: Mana Regeneration; Brawncap: Strength; Embercap: Fire Resistance; Swiftcap: Speed; Leapcap: Jump Boost.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mushrooms: Mendcap: Regeneration; Ghostcap: Invisibility; Toxcap: Poison; Stonecap: Resistance; Tidecap: Water Breathing. They glow faintly; the Sourcecap and the blue one glow brightest.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mudzya: A little jelly that floats in the air as if that were perfectly normal. A see-through cyan dome, a pink core, big eyes, fin-ears. Bli-Bliks live around their hive (wild ones stand on beaches, but they accept yours without questions) and never fly more than 8 blocks from it. Every couple of minutes a Bli-Blik fills up with Source and glows; full, it unloads into its hive or gives its Source to a glass bottle. Follows and breeds with sourceberries. What it thinks with is unknown, but it is clearly thinking something nice.
arcane_artifacts.page1.gribushka: The mushroom folk of the Mushroom Caves: a cap, shelf fungi on the sides, short arms and legs, and the calm, level face of someone who has seen things. When a Mycelinoid meets a friend it waves. Sometimes, for no reason, the whole colony starts dancing, and then, for no reason, stops. Throw a Mycelinoid a mushroom and it lifts it to its face, turns it over, rubs its chin, nods and throws back what it is worth. Blue: glow berries or glowstone; Sourcecap: Source gems; Brawncap: iron; Embercap: blaze powder; Swiftcap: sugar; Leapcap: a rabbit's foot.
arcane_artifacts.page2.gribushka: Mendcap: glistering melon; Ghostcap: phantom membrane; Toxcap: spider eyes; Stonecap: amethyst; Tidecap: prismarine. They take the plain ones too: brown mushroom for bone meal, red for redstone, crimson fungus for nether wart, warped fungus for an ender pearl.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mudzya_hive: Made of archwood planks. Bli-Bliks within 16 blocks without a home adopt it and stay within 8 blocks; full ones unload 50 Source each (up to 2000). Every 5 seconds the hive gives its Source to Source Jars within 6 blocks, or to a Mana Pipe nearby, which carries it into the Mana Tanks. A glass bottle takes 100 Source out as a Bottle of Source. Wild Bli-Blik Hives grow on beaches: they work the same, and break into a Bottle of Source unless you use Silk Touch.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mudzya_hive: "The hive hums in a key no bee has ever heard. Mr. Splotch says it is A-flat and that he does not want to talk about it." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.bottle_of_source: From a full Bli-Blik or a Bli-Blik Hive. A crafting resource (the Alchemical Distiller needs one), an ingredient that adds Mana Regeneration to distilled potions, and poured into a Source Jar it gives back 100 Source. Tastes like the future. Drinking is not recommended.
arcane_artifacts.page1.alchemical_distil: A brewing station two blocks wide and two high. Like a brewing stand, but every ingredient in its four ingredient slots adds its own effect to the same potion: up to four effects at once. Plain bottles (water, awkward, mundane, thick) go in the three bottle slots.
arcane_artifacts.page2.alchemical_distil: Each brew takes 200 Source from Source Jars within 6 blocks and one charge of nether wart blocks (a block gives 3). Modifier slot: redstone - twice as long, glowstone - one level stronger but half as long, gunpowder - splash, dragon's breath - lingering. Ingredients: brewing-stand ones and cave mushrooms.
arcane_artifacts.lore.alchemical_distill: "Why brew one potion when you can brew four at once and not know which one will explode?" - Hellmerus Morra. "Was that rhetorical?" - Pip. "It is now." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.false_mage_guide.d: Everything a Pseudomage needs to fake it.
item.arcane_artifacts.revolver.lore: Six chambers, one glyph, zero mana, one complicated family history.
item.arcane_artifacts.revolver.desc.1: 6 shots without reloading. Set one effect glyph inside at the Scribes Table.
item.arcane_artifacts.sawn_off.lore: Accuracy is overrated. Closeness is not.
item.arcane_artifacts.sawn_off.desc.1: 2 shots of 6 spreading pellets each, every pellet weakened by two Dampen.
item.arcane_artifacts.bandolier.lore: Worn across the chest. Like responsibility.
item.arcane_artifacts.bandolier.desc.1: 8 pouches of 16 Magic Cartridges (128). Use or press B to open.
item.arcane_artifacts.bandolier.desc.2: Worn: the cartridges are your false mana; firearms reload from it first.
item.arcane_artifacts.bandolier.desc.3: Shows on the chest, loaded with cartridges.
item.arcane_artifacts.counterfeit_ring.l: Looks magical. Tastes like brass. Do not ask how we know.
item.arcane_artifacts.counterfeit_ring.d: +15% movement speed and step up full blocks.
Gives no mana of any kind.
item.arcane_artifacts.counterfeit_pendan: The amber is real. Everything else is creative interpretation.
Gives no mana of any kind.
item.arcane_artifacts.mana_goggles.lore: Mages feel mana. Pseudomages measure it. Pip hugs it.
Look at a Mana Tank or a Source Jar to see exactly how much Source is inside.
Worn on the head or in a Curios head slot.
arcane_artifacts.gun.invalid: A firearm takes exactly one effect glyph: no form, no augments.
arcane_artifacts.gun.empty_glyph: No glyph inside: set one at the Scribes Table
arcane_artifacts.gun.no_ammo: No false mana and no cartridges to load
arcane_artifacts.page1.pseudomage: Not every wizard has mana. The Pseudomage has none at all and does not regret it, at least not out loud. He measures magic, keeps it in tanks, pumps it through pipes and fires it out of guns. None of his gear gives mana or mana regeneration. That is not a flaw. That is a worldview.
arcane_artifacts.page2.pseudomage: His researches have their own tab in the header of the Research Table. Firearms (gunpowder) gives the guns, cartridges and the bandolier; Logistics (copper) gives tanks, pipes and goggles; Counterfeit (gold nugget, after Firearms) gives the ring, pendant, poncho and sombrero. His gear is made of gold, leather and Amber.
arcane_artifacts.page3.pseudomage: Firearms fire one effect glyph set inside them at the Scribes Table. They need no mana: each shot is a cartridge, taken from the bandolier first and then from the inventory.
arcane_artifacts.page1.false_mana: False mana is the cartridges in your worn bandolier: an orange bar over the hotbar, split into 8 divisions of 16. It never regenerates and nothing refills it: only cartridges you put in.
arcane_artifacts.page2.false_mana: False mana is not mana: Ars spells cannot use it. Each shot loaded uses one cartridge; the bar shows exactly how many shots you have left.
arcane_artifacts.page1.false_mage_guide: Old parchment, gunpowder and Amber. It describes everything of the Pseudomage; what is not yet researched stays "???".
arcane_artifacts.lore.false_mage_guide: "Written by a man who failed the entrance exam and opened a shop across from the academy. The shop makes more than the academy. We do not talk about it." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.revolver: Six shots without reloading, fast and accurate. One effect glyph is set inside at the Scribes Table (from a spell book or the Archmage Staff); bullets are orange and release the glyph where they hit.
arcane_artifacts.page2.revolver: When it is empty, use it again (or crouch + use any time) to reload. No mana is ever spent, and the shooter takes no recoil from the glyph.
arcane_artifacts.lore.revolver: "I told him a mage does not need a gun. He told me a gun does not need a mage. We both went quiet. Somewhere outside a duck flew past." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.sawn_off: Two shots without reloading, six pellets per shot in a wide spread. Every pellet carries the glyph weakened by two Dampen. Close range is its natural habitat.
arcane_artifacts.lore.sawn_off: "It solves problems. Mostly one: the problem of standing too close. But that one, flawlessly." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.magic_cartridge: Gunpowder, Amber, a copper ingot and a Bottle of Source make 8 cartridges. They stack to 16, like snowballs. One cartridge is one shot.
arcane_artifacts.lore.magic_cartridge: "Source in a shell. Do not shake. Do not open. Do not name it. Pip already named it. It is called Boris." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.bandolier: Body slot. Eight pouches of 16 cartridges each; open it with use or the B key. While worn, its cartridges are your false mana and firearms reload from it first. It is visible on the chest, and the cartridges in its loops too.
arcane_artifacts.lore.bandolier: "Belts are for trousers. This is for ambitions. Pip wore it on his trousers. We were silent for a long time." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.counterfeit_ring: Ring slot. +15% movement speed and you walk up full blocks without jumping. It gives no mana: a Pseudomage travels light.
arcane_artifacts.lore.counterfeit_ring: "The jeweller swore it was enchanted. It is: enchanted to look enchanted. That is work too, and honestly, hard work." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.counterfeit_penda: Necklace slot. The amber gathers what little light there is: night vision while worn. Perfect for caves and deserts at night.
arcane_artifacts.lore.counterfeit_pendan: "Wear it to receptions. Never to duels. To funerals only if the deceased was a Pseudomage too." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mana_goggles: On the head (or in a Curios head slot). Looking at a Mana Tank shows its exact Source and size, at a Source Jar its exact Source.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mana_goggles: "Mages feel mana. Pseudomages measure it. Pip tried to hug it. The goggles showed zero." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mana_tank: Holds 10 000 Source per block. Tank blocks placed together become one tank up to 3 x 3 wide and 5 high, framed only along its outer edges like one big vessel, with windows running the whole height. Build the base (1 x 1, 2 x 2 or 3 x 3), then put one tank on top: the whole new layer is built at once, using tanks from your inventory. Source fills from the bottom up.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mana_tank: Fill it with Bottles of Source, or connect it with Mana Pipes: Ars machines next to a pipe (Sourcelinks, the Bli-Blik Hive, Imbuement Chambers, Enchanting Apparatus...) put Source into the tanks and take it from them as if they were Source Jars. No jars needed.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mana_tank: "Mana in a barrel. The ancient archmages are turning in their crypts. Mr. Splotch thinks barrels would be a fine way to keep ancient archmages too." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mana_pipe: Copper and glass, 8 per craft. Connects Mana Tanks into a network; every pipe acts as a Source Jar for nearby Ars blocks, filling and draining the tanks it reaches.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mana_pipe: "Plumbing is the final frontier of magic. I did not think I would live to see it. I thought I would die earlier, and more beautifully." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Firearms
Gunpowder throws stones further than any mage. The question nobody wanted to ask: what if it threw spells?
Get caught in an explosion
Set something on fire with Ignite
Cast a spell with the Projectile form
A spell does not care how it is thrown. (Revolver, Sawn-off, cartridges, bandolier)
Logistics
Copper conducts lightning, so it will conduct Source, so magic will get plumbing, so magic will get plumbers. The world is not ready.
Conjure water onto a block
Pick something up with Pickup
Cast a spell with the Touch form
Source flows like water if you give it a pipe, and a pump. (Mana Tank, Mana Pipe, Mana Pump, Goggles)
Counterfeit
If it looks like mana and shines like mana, it is probably amber. But magic is a trusting creature.
Become invisible
Smelt a block with a spell
Cast Dispel
Magic believes what it is told. (Counterfeit ring and pendant, poncho, sombrero, spurred boots)
item.arcane_artifacts.druid_herbarium.de: The druid is still growing. Come back after the next update.
arcane_artifacts.page1.druid: The third path: a mage who does not cast against the world but grows with it. The Druid will tame beasts, speak with roots and turn seasons into spells. Pip asked whether he can speak with roots already. He can. They just do not answer.
arcane_artifacts.page2.druid: This herbarium is only a seedling. The first Druid research (Awakening) is already on the Research Table, in its own tab. The rest will sprout in later updates. Plants are in no hurry, and they advise the same.
arcane_artifacts.page1.druid_herbarium: Leaves, a sapling and old parchment. Pressed flowers between the pages and the smell of moss.
arcane_artifacts.lore.druid_herbarium: "Plants were doing magic long before us and never wrote a single book about it. That is either modesty or contempt. I lean towards the second." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.research.arcane_artifac: Awakening
Listen to what grows. It grows very slowly and is in no hurry to explain itself.
Make a block grow with a spell
Harvest with a spell
Heal a creature with a spell
Everything alive answers to Source. (The Druid is coming)
item.arcane_artifacts.poncho.lore: Smells of dust, gunpowder and a conversation that never happened.
item.arcane_artifacts.poncho.desc.1: Stand still to gain Duel Focus: +1 Amplify every 2 seconds, up to 5.
item.arcane_artifacts.poncho.desc.2: A duel tune plays while you stand. Moving breaks the focus.
arcane_artifacts.page1.poncho: Back slot. While you stand still, the Poncho gathers Duel Focus: one level every 2 seconds, up to 5. Each level adds one Amplify to every spell and every shot. A step breaks the focus.
arcane_artifacts.page2.poncho: After a second of stillness a slow duel tune starts to play, on note blocks nobody placed. It stops as soon as you move.
arcane_artifacts.lore.poncho: "Draw first. Cast second. Explain never. Especially to Mr. Splotch; he has a form for explanations and it is nine pages long." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.sombrero.lore: Shade for the eyes, amber for the aim, a brim for the drama.
item.arcane_artifacts.sombrero.desc.1: Works as Pseudomage's Goggles: shows the Source in tanks and jars.
item.arcane_artifacts.sombrero.desc.2: 15% chance for an attack to be a critical hit (x1.5 damage).
arcane_artifacts.page1.sombrero: Head slot (or Curios head slot). Shows exact Source in Mana Tanks and Source Jars like the goggles, and every attack has a 15% chance to be critical: x1.5 damage.
arcane_artifacts.lore.sombrero: "In a hat this wide every shot feels lucky. Some even are. The rest are just shady." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.duel_focus: Pseudomage's Poncho. Standing still sharpens the aim: each level adds one Amplify to spells and shots. Lost at the first step.
arcane_artifacts.page1.amber: Orange crystals lie in deserts like flowers on the sand, and grow on cave walls and ceilings under them. Break a cluster for 1-2 Amber (Fortune helps, Silk Touch takes the cluster). Every Pseudomage craft is made with Amber.
arcane_artifacts.mana_tank.blocked: Something is in the way of the new tank layer.
arcane_artifacts.mana_tank.need: The new layer needs %s Mana Tanks, you have %s.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mana_pump: Put it in a pipe line; the arrow on top shows where Source goes. Every second it moves up to 1000 Source from the tanks behind it (the intake) to the tanks in front (the outlet): Tank A -> pipe -> pump -> pipe -> Tank B. The pump splits the network in two, so Source only goes one way. A redstone signal stops it.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mana_pump: "It goes chug. Then chug again. Pip listens to it at night because "it is the only one who understands his rhythm"." - Hellmerus Morra
item.arcane_artifacts.pseudomage_boots.l: The spurs jingle at every step. The horse understands.
item.arcane_artifacts.pseudomage_boots.d: +30% movement speed. Magma blocks do not burn.
The spurs make your mount 30% faster too.
arcane_artifacts.page1.pseudomage_boots: Feet slot. Worn-in leather riding boots with brass spurs. +30% movement speed, you walk over magma blocks without burning, and whatever you ride (a horse, a donkey, a camel...) gets 30% faster while you sit on it.
arcane_artifacts.lore.pseudomage_boots: "A real wizard teleports. A Pseudomage arrives on time. That is rarer, and deserves respect." - Hellmerus Morra
The Druid is still growing: this gear does nothing yet.
item.arcane_artifacts.druid_hat.desc.1: The Druid is still growing: this gear does nothing yet.
The Druid is still growing: this gear does nothing yet.
item.arcane_artifacts.druid_boots.desc.1: The Druid is still growing: this gear does nothing yet.
arcane_artifacts.page1.druid_gear: A mantle of leaves (back slot), a hat with a sprout on top (head), bark gloves (hands) and moss-lined boots (feet). They can already be worn, but the Druid's powers will only take root in a coming update.
item.arcane_artifacts.mushroom_shield.de: A blocked blow bursts into a cloud of spores (once every 2 s).
The cloud hurts and infects foes, and speeds up you and your friends.
item.arcane_artifacts.mushroom_club.desc: Slow and heavy. Every hit dusts the target with spores: spore damage and the Spore Infection.
arcane_artifacts.effect_doc.spore_infect: Mycelinoid spores in the nose: a sneeze every 2.5 seconds (a moment of standing still and a little damage), and every sneeze passes the spores to monsters nearby. Only creatures with a nose and lungs catch it: skeletons, blazes, golems, slimes, spiders and the like do not, and the Mycelinoids never do.
arcane_artifacts.page1.amanitoid: The guardian of a Mycelinoid colony: a big fly agaric with a red, white-spotted cap and a face that has not changed in three hundred years. It does not trade. Like an iron golem it walks the village and fights creepers, the undead (zombies, skeletons and the like), witches, raiders and spiders of every kind, and anyone who hurts a Mycelinoid or itself.
arcane_artifacts.page2.amanitoid: It carries a Mushroom Club and a Mushroom Shield. In a fight it raises the shield, and every blow that lands on it bursts into a cloud of spores. Pip once asked an Amanitoid whether it was happy. The Amanitoid was quiet for a long time, then straightened its cap and went back on guard. Pip thinks that was a yes.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mushroom_shield: When it blocks a blow it bursts into a spore cloud (at most once every 2 seconds) for 4 seconds, 3 blocks around. In the cloud foes (monsters, and whoever is after you or a Mycelinoid) take spore damage and catch the Spore Infection; you, other players and Mycelinoids get Speed. Repaired with mushroom blocks.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mushroom_shield: "It is a mushroom. It is a shield. Against all the laws it is both at once, and it does not want your pity." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mushroom_club: Slow (0.7 blows a second) but heavy (9 damage). Every hit dusts the target with spores, like the shield's cloud without the Speed: a moment later spore damage, and the Spore Infection. Repaired with mushroom stems.
arcane_artifacts.lore.mushroom_club: "Mycelinoid diplomacy, final draft. The first four drafts were words. They did not work." - Hellmerus Morra
arcane_artifacts.page1.mycelinoid_houses: Mycelinoid villages stand only in large Mushroom Caves: a hall in the middle and 2 to 7 houses around it, 3 to 8 in all. Every house is a huge mushroom with a door and glass windows cut into its stem, a floor of mushroom planks and a shroomlight under the cap. To find one: /locate structure arcane_artifacts:mycelinoid_village.
arcane_artifacts.page2.mycelinoid_houses: Each house has its use. The hall holds a long table for the whole colony. In dwellings they sleep on moss mats; storehouses are full of barrels; on farms mushrooms grow on mushroom moss; the brewery has a brewing stand and a cauldron; in the guardhouse the Amanitoids keep spare clubs and shields.
arcane_artifacts.page1.mushroom_wood: A red, brown or blue mushroom block gives 4 mushroom planks. From them, like from any wood: stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors, buttons and pressure plates. Two blocks of mushroom moss make 3 moss carpets.
arcane_artifacts.page1.cave_ground: Mushroom moss lies in patches in the Mushroom Caves, and between the patches the ground shows: dirt, coarse dirt, mud and mycelium. Spore tufts, glowsprouts and plain mushrooms grow on the mycelium and dirt, hyphae hang from the ceilings, and here and there lilac Spore Clay. Pip asked why a cave has such ordinary ground. Morra said a cave has a right to something ordinary too.
arcane_artifacts.page2.cave_ground: Blue mushroom flesh is springy: whoever falls on a blue mushroom block, spotted, glowing or gills, takes no damage and bounces back up (sneak to land softly). Besides the huge blue mushrooms, ordinary huge mushrooms grow in the caves too, red and brown. They are not springy at all. This is important to know in advance.
arcane_artifacts.page3.mycelinoid_houses: Between the houses run moss paths with lamp posts, a well stands by the hall, and on the outskirts there is a watchtower with a ladder inside and an Amanitoid on its lookout, a market of three stalls, and a fenced garden of every cave mushroom. Villages lie deep, at the level of the deepslate caves.
